name: map-framework
description: Modular Agentic Planner (MAP) - Cognitive architecture for AI agents with 11 specialized agents and professional code review integration
author: azalio
features: 9 specialized MAP agents (TaskDecomposer, Actor, Monitor, Predictor, Evaluator, Reflector, DocumentationReviewer, Research-Agent, Final-Verifier)
5 Claude Code hooks for automation (validate-agent-templates, auto-store-knowledge, enrich-context, session-init, track-metrics)
Semantic pattern search with embeddings cache
Cost optimization with per-agent model selection (haiku/sonnet/opus)

steps: Clone repository from GitHub or copy MAP framework files to your project
Run 'mapify init' to initialize project with MAP agents
Start using /map-* commands in Claude Code
